What quantity in the campaign means
You can determine and submit a specific quantity of products for a given offer to some campaigns on Allegro. It means that once customers buy all the units at the promotional price, the offer will stop participating in the campaign and become available outside it again.
You provide the quantity you want to sell in a given campaign when submitting offers. You will see the
Quantity in the campaign
field. There, you can enter the number of units you want to sell in the selected campaign.

You can declare more units than you have in your offer at the moment of submission, but the quantity must fall within the range specified for that product. You can find the information on ranges in the
Campaigns and programs
tab — below the field with your declared quantity.
For example, you declare 100 units in a campaign with a range of 80–100 units for that product. You have 90 units in your offer — and you can submit 90 units to that campaign.

Before you pack products for shipment, make sure they are properly labeled and secured.
Unit packaging
Products you ship to the Allegro Warehouse must come in the original and sealed packaging that protects from:
spilling or leaking
having free access to its content
mechanical damage
dirt.
In addition, when you ship to the Allegro Warehouse products whose packaging is the integral part (for example, jewelry in decorative packaging) — secure it as well. You can use, for example:
shrink wrap
foil bags sealed with barcode labels
seals.

If you ship to the warehouse a product in unit packaging and additional protective packaging (for example, in a plastic bag), we will not unpack it before measuring. We will measure it in the packaging and consider those dimensions valid.
This may make the dimensions of such a product larger enough to qualify it for a different price category
. Learn more about
measuring products
.

Check what you should pay attention to for specific product groups.

You can
conditionally ship
lithium-ion, lithium polymer, lithium metal, sodium-ion batteries, and devices containing such batteries to the Allegro Warehouse. Before you do it, pack and label them correctly.
Use packaging that protects them from damage and prevents them from moving within the packaging (this does not apply to batteries placed in devices). Then, put them in a durable and rigid bulk packaging.
Both batteries and devices containing batteries should be packed in packaging that withstands a fall from a height of 1.2 m (in any position) — without damage, battery displacement, or release of contents.
Make sure that the weight of batteries with packaging does not exceed 30 kg.
If you ship devices with batteries, secure them so they cannot turn on during transport.
Secure batteries against short-circuiting or possible contact with electrically conductive materials (if shipped in the same packaging). This applies particularly to batteries that were not pre-packed. Pack such batteries yourself - for example, in a plastic bag.
Place an appropriate sticker on each packaging.
Provide the UN number (starting with "UN") applicable to the batteries in the packaging in the spot marked with an asterisk. You can check them in

We handle products with a minimum shelf life of no less than 6 months from the date of acceptance to the Allegro Warehouse.
If a product has a specified expiration date, it should be visible on the product or the unit packaging. If it is not visible — we will not accept the product for storage.
Pack products with the same expiration date and batch number into one carton. Do not pack products with different expiration dates and batch numbers into one carton.
If your products expire in less than 60 days — we will send them back to you at your cost. In addition — other of your products stored in our warehouse are unfit for sale — we will send them all back to you in a single shipment.

EAN (GTIN) code
GTIN is an EAN or other code — learn more about it in
this article
. With that code we can identify products you ship to the Allegro Warehouse. That is why:
the code should be valid and come from a legal source Learn how to check the validity of EAN below
each of your products should be marked with this code or have a label with this code. If a product comes in a protective packaging, the EAN (GTIN) code should also be placed on it.
the code should be visible, clear, and scannable. It is best to place it on a flat surface — not on the edges and folds
each of your products should be marked with only one code. If a given product has additional codes, cover them or black them out with a marker.

Place all products in cartons. Use durable cartons that will not tear or brake.
Pack products in a way that will prevent them from moving inside the carton. Fill any remaining empty space in the carton. You can, for example, use air cushions, bubble wrap, sheets of paper, or corrugated cardboard. Seal every carton — you can, for example, use a tape or a stapler.
If you ship cartons to the Allegro Warehouse via a courier company, mark them according to their requirements.
If you ship your products in recycled cartons, remove any old labels and stickers or black them out with a marker.
Do not cover the cartons completely with tape and do no wrap them with stretch foil. You can wrap cartons with stretch foil only if you place them on a pallet collectively.

How we calculate delivery costs for different price lists
If the buyer orders products in several of your offers where you have:
the same price list, or different price lists with the same delivery options or settings, such as price, number of units in the parcel, and the maximum parcel weight
— we will add up the quantity in all offers. We will calculate the delivery cost as if the purchase is related to one offer only.
price lists with the same delivery option but different settings
— we will calculate the delivery cost and the number of labels for the order according to the method you selected for combining price lists
price lists without the same delivery option
— the buyer will be able to enter their custom cost manually. In that case, they should discuss it with you in advance.

The customer buys from you in 2 offers. In both of them, you have price lists with the same delivery option — Allegro DPD Courier. However, in the price lists, other settings differ, for example:
the maximum number of units per parcel
the fee for each subsequent unit in the parcel
the maximum weight.
That means we will calculate the delivery cost and the number of labels for the order according to the method you selected for combining price lists.

How to set the method of calculating delivery costs
Go to the
Delivery Settings
tab.
Click [edit] in the
Delivery costs for the buyer
section.
Select one of the available cost calculation methods. You can select:
the most expensive delivery — the buyer will pay the amount for delivery that we calculate based on the price list with
the highest delivery cost
. In addition, according to that price list and the offers in which it is added, we will generate the number of labels for the whole order.
the cheapest delivery — the buyer will pay the amount for delivery that we calculate based on the price list with
the lowest delivery cost
. In addition, according to that price list and the offers in which it is added, we will generate the number of labels for the whole order.
the sum of deliveries — we will dispatch the orders from individual offers in separate parcels and the buyer will pay for each of them.

The customer buys from you in 3 different offers with 3 different price lists. Each price list contains the same delivery option but with different settings such as price, the maximum number of units in the parcel, and the maximum parcel weight.
In that case, we automatically compare all the price lists:
price list number 1 (the first offer) — the customer bought 2 units, the maximum number of units in the parcel is 2, and the parcel cost is 12 PLN. We generate 1 label. The delivery cost is 12 PLN.
price list number 2 (the second offer) — the customer bought 3 units, the maximum number of units in the parcel is 8, and the parcel cost is 14 PLN. We generate 1 label. The delivery cost is 14 PLN.
price list number 3 (the third offer) — the customer bought 4 units, the maximum number of units in the parcel is 2, and the parcel cost is 14 PLN. We generate 2 labels. The delivery cost is 28 PLN.
We automatically compare costs from all the price lists and select only one of them, according to your settings. We do not take into consideration your other price lists.
If, according to your settings, the customer should pay the highest delivery cost, we will automatically select the price list number 3. In that case, the customer will pay 28 PLN and you will generate 2 labels for the whole order.
If, according to your settings, the customer should pay the lowest delivery cost, we will automatically select the price list number 1. In that case, the customer will pay 12 PLN and you will generate 1 label for the whole order.
If you select the option to sum the deliveries, we will settle each offer separately. In that case, the customer will pay 54 PLN, and 4 labels will be assigned to that order.

No matter which method you choose, you can also enable the buyer to enter the delivery cost manually — after they have discussed it with you. The buyer will be able to enter the delivery cost while making the purchase — in the delivery and payment form.

What offer sharing is all about
Our rule is:
list once — sell everywhere
. If you want to sell in foreign marketplaces, you do not need to list new offers. All you need to do is submit them for sharing. Once you do it, we check whether they meet all requirements. The verification process usually takes a couple of minutes. If you submit several offers at the same time, we may need more time to process them.
In foreign marketplaces, you can share offers
listed on a business account with at least Neutral
sales quality level
that do not contain products that cannot be sold in a given marketplace
that are available to customers with regular accounts
that come in the
buy now
format
that are not charity offers, auctions, or classifieds
that are linked to the
Allegro Product Catalog
or are product sets
where you enabled international delivery options — at least one for each marketplace you want to share them in
that have been automatically or manually
translated into the language of a given marketplace
— except offers listed in
those categories
where you provide prices in the currency of a given marketplace
that are listed in categories available in the particular foreign marketplace.
How you can meet the requirements
You have already met some of them — as they are the entry requirements for joining One Fulfillment.  They involve holding a business account, the sales format of offers, and linking products to the Product Catalog. You can meet the remaining requirements through the options we enable on Allegro or within One Fulfillment.
To make your offers available to customers with regular accounts, go to the listing form and tick the
all customers
option in the
Who can purchase
the offer section.

.

You can only sell alcoholic beverages on Allegro after signing a separate agreement with us. To do so, please contact us.

If you want to sell in the Alcohol category, you must:
have a business account
have the appropriate authorizations, which we will verify
operate a brick-and-mortar retail outlet
offer the option of in-person pickup at your point of sale
and
a special DPD delivery method:
Allegro courier for age-restricted products
.
During delivery, the courier will check the sobriety and age of the recipient of the shipment and the PIN code that the buyer will receive from the carrier. Age verification is based solely on a physical document (passport, driver's license, ID card) – it is not possible in the mObywatel app.

You can sell alcohol on Smart! and outside of the service. For a customer to be eligible for Smart! delivery, the order value from a single seller must be at least:
65 PLN — if they activated Allegro Smart! before March 2, 2026
49.90 PLN — if they activated Allegro Smart! on or after March 2, 2026.
Learn more
.
You can also
set up free delivery for orders above a certain amount
.
The commission on sales in the Alcohol category is 5% net (6.15% gross).
The Alcohol category is only available on allegro.pl.
It is not possible to ship orders containing alcohol from Poland abroad or from abroad to Poland.
You can withdraw money from sales from the Funds and transaction history tab once the courier has collected the parcel from you or once you have marked in the Orders tab that the customer has collected the order in person. This applies to the amount for the entire order containing products from the Alcohol category.
Separate rules apply in the Alcohol category with regard to sales support offers.

Once we sign the agreement, we will email you a form in which you will:

We will inform you of the verification result by email within 2–3 days.

30 days before your license expires, we will ask you to send us a new one by email. Please send us your new license at least 14 days before your current one expires. If you fail to do so, we will automatically terminate all your listings in the Alcohol category and block you from posting new listings in this category until your new license has been verified. You will then be able to easily resume your terminated listings.
In accordance with the agreement, we are entitled to randomly check your permissions even after positive verification – when you are already selling alcohol. We may therefore ask you to resend your documents.
If you want to expand your product range to include alcoholic beverages that require a different license than the one we have already verified, please fill out the same form again. While we verify your new license, you can continue selling as usual.

The content of offers involving alcoholic beverages must be formulated in accordance with the law and the principles of social responsibility
. Alcohol offers may not:
be directed at minors or depict them in any form
suggest that alcohol consumption improves physical performance

encourage excessive alcohol consumption
portray abstinence or moderate consumption in a negative light
emphasize high alcohol content as a feature that improves the quality of the beverage.
You are fully responsible for the content of your offers.

A combined order, i.e., one that includes alcoholic beverages and products outside the Alcohol category, must be fulfilled in accordance with the rules for orders containing only alcoholic beverages.

Before you ship dangerous products to the Allegro Warehouse, take a look at our glossary. It contains the definitions of basic terms that you may find useful while preparing products for dispatch. If you need more information, contact the ADR advisor or use the materials prepared by the relevant entities — for example, the
Polish Ministry of Infrastructure
.
Glossary

Dangerous products
are objects, materials, or substances that can pose risks in storage or transport. This includes threats to health, the environment, and property. Such products can be, for example, corrosive, flammable, poisonous, or pressurized. Those also include some products commonly used in households — such as spray deodorants, adhesives, paints, laptops, and cell phones.

The ADR agreement
is the international agreement concerning the carriage of dangerous goods. It comprises provisions for road transport, cargo security, or labeling of dangerous substances
Learn more
(available in Polish).

The ADR special provisions
constitute
chapter 3.3 of the ADR agreement
. They concern selected chemical substances and dangerous materials.  Thanks to them you will know whether a product marked with a specific UN number requires, for example, special parcel marking or is exempt from the ADR regulations.

The CLP regulation
is the EU regulation under which substances and mixtures are classified. The main purpose of this document is to identify potentially dangerous substances and mixtures. The regulation also informs how to:
pack and mark such substances and mixtures before introducing them on the market
store, transport, and dispose of such substances and mixtures
prevent and counteract possible risks associated with these substances and mixtures.
Learn more
(available in Polish).

The safety data sheet
(SDS) is a document that informs about the risks posed by a given substance or mixture. Based on that information, we decide whether to accept a given product for storage at the Allegro Warehouse. The safety data sheet also informs how to store the products in question and what to do in case of an accident or leak.
In the context of One Fulfillment, the most important SDS information can be found in:
Section 2, which contains information about the type of hazard (H-phrases)
Section 14, which contains information about the transport, UN number, packing group, and any special regulations.
The manufacturer, importer, or supplier is responsible for providing the product's safety data sheet. The safety data

Section 14, which contains information about the transport, UN number, packing group, and any special regulations.
The manufacturer, importer, or supplier is responsible for providing the product's safety data sheet. The safety data sheet can come in a paper or electronic form. It should be available in the language of the country where you sell a given product. It means that if you sell within One Fulfillment also in foreign marketplaces, we may ask you to present the safety data sheet in the respective languages.

The UN is a 4-digit identification number used to mark dangerous substances and products. The full list of UN numbers is available in the ADR agreement.
If a given product is subject to the ADR provisions, information about its UN number can be found in section 14(1) of the safety data sheet.

Hazard phrases (H-phrases)
are codes usually composed of one letter and three digits that inform about the risks a given substance or mixture can pose.
Information about the H-phrase should be placed on the product label. The list of H-phrases is available in the CLP regulation.

How to sign in with a passkey
A passkey is a secure sign-in method that does not require you to create a separate password. You will sign in to Allegro the same way you unlock your device — for example, with a fingerprint, face scan, or PIN.
How it works
When you set the passkey, we will create a secure connection between your Allegro account and the device you use. During the sign-in, you just unlock the device with the set sign-in method, confirming your identity that way.
Most of the verification takes place locally on your device. All we receive is the confirmation that you succeeded.
We do not access your data, such as PIN, fingerprint, or face scan
. You get improved security and convenience.

If you wish, you can use other sign-in methods on a chosen device — even if you have enabled the passkey sign-in.

When you can use the passkeys
To sign in with a passkey, you need:
an up-to-date version of one of the popular browsers, for example, Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Opera, or Microsoft Edge
a secure program to store passkeys, such as Apple Keychain or Google Password Manager — such programs are often installed by default by the device manufacturer.

If your passkey storage program uses the cloud, you will be able to sign in with this method on multiple devices.
For programs that do not use the cloud, you can create separate passkeys for different devices.

What the sales currency is
It is the currency in which you set prices of your offers and receive payments for orders from specific marketplaces. If you want to sell in a marketplace other than the one you registered in, set prices in the corresponding currency. That means in PLN for allegro.pl, CZK for allegro.cz, and EUR for allegro.sk.

You list an offer on allegro.pl and you share it on allegro.cz. Your offer has two sales currencies because it is available on two markets. You receive payments from buyers from Czechia and Poland. You will have separate subaccounts for each market that will allow you to easily settle with us:
for sales on allegro.pl we will charge you the fees in PLN
for sales on allegro.cz we will charge you the fees in CZK.
That is why we will issue a separate invoice for each market: in CZK and in PLN.

What the payment currency is
It is the currency in which the buyer sees the prices of products on a given Allegro domain and in which they can pay for their order. Regardless of the currency in which the buyer pays for their order, the payment operator will transfer the money to you in the sales currency of a given market.

The buyer in Germany browses allegro.pl — they see offers with prices in EUR and pay for their order in PLN. You receive the payment for sales in PLN.

How we measure products on accepting them for storage at the warehouse
When you ship a product we have not handled before to the Allegro Warehouse, we measure and weigh it on reception. This way we know:
whether a given product meets our size and weight requirements
what fee we should charge for handling the product.

We measure product weight and dimensions using a device with a built-in laser. We measure and weigh the product in the packaging in which you ship it to the warehouse. We account for all packaging elements — also the protruding ones (when the product comes in an irregular shape or irregular protective packaging). We do not change the shape of the packaging — we do not fold or bend it to make the dimensions smaller. We consider the highest values (length, width, height) given by the device as valid.
What it means for you
If you pack products in protective packaging, pay attention to the dimensions of the packaged product. Even slight differences in size can increase or decrease the volume enough to qualify the product for a different price category.
If you do not always pack your products the same way, they may differ in size from the product you measured first. As a result, we can qualify the same product for different price categories.
Shipment discrepancies
If the number of products we have accepted for storage is different than the one you declared in the ASN and shipped to the warehouse, you can file a complaint. You can do that through the
the contact form
within 14 calendar days from the moment the ASN with a given shipment was marked as
completed

When we check your complaint and find an error on our side, we will update the inventory according to the actual state.
Additionally, if justified, we will compensate you in the amount of 100% of the product net worth. We will calculate compensation based on:
the price you provided in the offer with a given product
or
the invoice confirming the price for which you bought the product from the supplier.
We will compensate you within 45 calendar days from addressing the complaint.
Damaged products
The Allegro Warehouse does not accept products that are damaged or that come in damaged packaging. If we find that the damage was caused in transit to the warehouse (for example, that the pallets or boxes you used to ship products to the warehouse were damaged), we will document it. We will prepare a damage report and take photos of the damage — and send it all to you.
If the boxes or pallets show no visible damage but, on accepting products for storage, we find that some products are damaged — we will mark them as defective. Then:

When and how we check offers
We check offers before we publish them and right after the publication. We do it both automatically and manually.

Allegro Terms & Conditions

The offers we publish may still contain errors. If, after publication, we decide that the offer does not comply with our rules — we will terminate it.

From August 19, we will no longer be adding the
GREAT PRICE
badge to offers. We will focus on developing a single pricing program —
Best price guarantee
.
You can be awarded the GREAT PRICE badge in offers with the lowest prices only on allegro.pl. Under the Best price guarantee program, we additionally compare prices of products in your offers with prices in selected online stores.
Why we are doing it
Our research shows that two similar badges are confusing for buyers. They do not see the difference between GREAT PRICE and the Best price guarantee — they believe both highlight offers with the lowest price exclusively on allegro.pl.
Best price guarantee brings customers concrete benefits. This badge assures them that the offer on allegro.pl has both high quality and the lowest price among selected online stores — which means they do not need to look for the product anywhere else. The GREAT PRICE badge does not guarantee that. Additionally, offers with this badge are often not price-competitive on the market.
Our primary goal is to provide buyers with the most attractive prices and thereby build their trust in the Best price guarantee program.  This can translate into higher sales for your offers with this badge.
What will happen with offers with the GREAT PRICE badge
On August 19, we will stop displaying this badge in offers. If you want to increase your offer visibility:

If you have any reservations about how we handle orders, you can file a complaint.
How to file a complaint
You can file a complaint through
this form
. We will try to respond as soon as possible — however, in some cases, it may take us some time. We respond to complaints within 45 days at the latest.
What the complaint may refer to
Your complaint may refer to:
finances — for example, incorrectly charged fees
errors in fulfillment and delivery to the customer — for example, an incorrect number of products in a parcel or an incorrectly packed order
damaged or missing products — for example, a parcel that never reached the buyer
order delivery time — for example,  a parcel dispatched with a delay
dissatisfied customers — for example, a Discussion or a comment that clearly points to the error on the part of the Allegro Warehouse staff.
What to write in a complaint
Describe the problem in detail. Provide the necessary information — for example, the order number, the customer's login, or the parcel number.
If necessary — add attachments to the complaint. Those can be, for example, photos of a damaged parcel taken by the buyer.
Add information about the complaint claim — your expectations about fixing/resolving the problematic situation. One example of a complaint claim is compensation.

What the order discount is and how it works
With the
order discount
you can set discounts on your entire assortment within one cart if the buyer makes a purchase worth at least an amount you specified.
Within the order discount, you can set any number of thresholds at which the discount applies. The lowest threshold you can set is 2%

You give a 5% discount for a single order worth 10,000 PLN. For an order worth 25,000 PLN ― you give a 7% discount. For an order worth 50,000 PLN ― a 10% discount, and so on.

We add a discount in the buyer’s cart.
The order discount
does not include offers in which you have set a
wholesale discount
— a discount on a specific number of the selected product's units. Thanks to that, you can be sure the buyer will not get a double discount.

You have set the
order discount
for orders worth 6,000 PLN or more.
A buyer adds two products from your offers to the cart:
a scooter for 5,000 PLN
a bike for 2,000 PLN — in that offer, you have also set a
wholesale discount
that reduces the price for the purchase of at least 4 units.
The total cart value is over 6,000 PLN. However, the order discount only includes the scooter's value — 5,000 PLN — so less than the discount threshold. The buyer will not get a discount.

Who may benefit from the discount
Only
the sellers on their business accounts may offer the order discount.
Only
the business customers ― buyers signed in to their business accounts ― may benefit from the discounts.
How we display to buyers information about the discount

on the store page
when the buyer adds the product to cart
in the seller's offer.

Parameters should describe the properties of a product you sell in the most complete way possible. That is why they might be different depending on the category in which you list the offer.
Why you should complete the parameters
The buyer can filter search results and more easily find the product they are interested in.

You will receive details about the product, including its parameters, from the manufacturer or distributor of the goods. They are often listed on the packaging or in the operating instructions.

What the GTIN (EAN code) is
The GTIN (EAN code) is a unique product ID recognized worldwide. It can be 8, 12, 13, or 14 digits long. In Europe, it is usually GTIN-13, and you can find it on the product packaging below the EAN barcode.
The GTIN allows you to unambiguously identify a product. It is a market standard used by stores, retail chains, and e-commerce platforms.
How to obtain the GTIN (EAN code) — information for manufacturers
The GTIN (EAN code) is assigned by the manufacturer or brand owner.
If a product does not have a GTIN, contact the manufacturer. They should contact the
GS1 organization
(the only source of valid GTINs) to mark their products.
When a manufacturer obtains a GTIN, they must activate it — that is, enter it into the GS1 registry. The number will be present in the GS1 database only then, and it will be possible to use it to identify the product on the market.

The number will appear in the GS1 database within 24 hours of the moment it is assigned

Key rules regarding GTINs (EAN codes)
The most important rule to follow when assigning GTINs to products is the unique identification of each product with specific parameters. The GTIN (EAN code) identifies the product, not the right to its exclusive use by the brand owner.

The GTIN is assigned permanently. The GTIN cannot be reused for any product. If a manufacturer introduces changes to a product, for example, amends its features or creates a new brand, then, from a customer's perspective, it is a different product. For that reason, the manufacturer should create a new product and assign it a new GTIN.

How the GTIN (EAN code), manufacturer code, and serial number differ
The GTIN (EAN code)
is a unique number assigned by the GS1 organization. It consists only of numbers, does not contain letters or special characters. The manufacturer uses it during its commercial activities.
The manufacturer code
is assigned by the manufacturer and is unique for a single model or variant of the product. There are no standards for this type of code, so its length and the characters used are chosen by the manufacturer. It can contain both numbers and letters. The manufacturer uses it mainly to identify the product within its range. It may happen that products from different categories will have the same manufacturer code.
The serial number
is assigned by the manufacturer to the specific units of the product. Thanks to it, he can identify which series the product comes from, where it was manufactured or serviced.

What pre-made shipping price lists are
They are a simplified way of creating
shipping price lists
in a few easy steps. All you need to do is specify the country of dispatch and sale, and select the template. We will automatically complete the remaining information:
we will create a shipping price list containing appropriate delivery options, for which we will always automatically set
maximum delivery prices
if we make any changes to the delivery options, we will update the shipping price list automatically — based on the setting you choose (country of dispatch, assortment type).
The benefits of pre-made shipping price lists
Your shipping price lists are always Smart!
— the pre-made shipping price lists always meet the Allegro Smart! conditions in every marketplace.
Your delivery rates are always up-to-date
— in the shipping price lists, we automatically set the maximum delivery prices. If the rates change — we update them.
You always offer the latest delivery options
— if we enable a new delivery option that meets the conditions of your shipping price list, we automatically add it.

The delivery fee for the first unit is 10 PLN, you can ship up to 5 units within one parcel, and you set a surcharge of 1 PLN — in that case, when the buyer orders:

The delivery fee for the first unit is 10 PLN, you can ship up to 5 units within one parcel, and you set a surcharge of 0 PLN — in that case, when the buyer orders:
1–5 units — the delivery cost is 10 PLN
6–10 units — the delivery cost is 20 PLN

Example:
You sell dog food, whose weight with packaging is 2 kg. In the delivery price list, you set the following parameters for the Allegro DPD courier delivery option:

The customer buys 3 units of dog food from the offer, which together weigh 6 kg. The order exceeds the maximum parcel weight you have set as 5 kg. The customer pays 25.98 (2 x 12.99 PLN) for the delivery of that order. We charge them for another parcel — despite the fact that the maximum number of units in a parcel is 4.

How we determine parcel weight
We compare its actual and dimensional weight. We consider the higher value.
Actual weight
— how much the parcel weighs when placed on a scale.
Dimensional weight
— depends on the parcel's dimensions.
We calculate it with the following formula: [height (cm) x length (cm) x width (cm)] / 6,000.
If a parcel exceeds the maximum weight or dimensions — we will add a surcharge according to the
price list
.

On July 1, 2021, the VAT e-commerce package came into force. It means that for some B2C transactions concluded through the electronic platforms, sellers from outside the European Union now settle based on the new rules.
What it means
VAT on some B2C transactions is accounted for by trading platforms, such as Allegro ― instead of sellers. It means that we collect VAT from sellers on such transactions.
If the offer is taxable in Poland, the standard Polish VAT rate (23%) or one of reduced rates (8%, 5%, tax exemption) applies to it ― according to your declaration.
If the offer is taxable in the Czech Republic, the standard Czach VAT rate (21%) or one of reduced rates (12%, tax exemption) applies to it ― according to your declaration.
In the case of shipping to other EU countries, a VAT rate relevant for the country of destination applies.

All funds paid by the buyer will be transferred to
your Allegro Finance wallet
. We settle for the VAT e-commerce Package through billing ― we will add a relevant fee in the
Settlements with Allegro
tab on your account. You will see this settlement in the invoices you receive from us monthly, as well.

How the change affects refunds for buyers
If you issue a refund, either
automatically
or manually, we will add a correction in the
Settlements with Allegro
tab as soon as possible.
Always refund the buyer the
gross
price. We will refund you a collected VAT as a correction in the billing as soon as possible.
Whom this change affects
Sellers with their business seats outside the European Union who ship their orders from the European Union
This change affects transactions concluded by the sellers with their business seat outside the European Union who do not have a fixed establishment in the European Union within the VAT regulations if the goods are shipped to buyers from the European Union.

We settle transactions according to the new rules if:
your business is based in China
you do not have a fixed establishment within the meaning of tax regulations in the European Union, and
you send goods to buyers in Poland from a warehouse in Germany.

This change
does not affect
sellers who dispatch their parcels from outside the European Union. We do not account for VAT from such transactions.

We do
not
account for VAT according to the new rules if:
your business is based in China or the US
you dispatch parcels
tytul: The VAT e-commerce package ― general information for sellers

tekst:
sellers who dispatch their parcels from outside the European Union. We do not account for VAT from such transactions.

We do
not
account for VAT according to the new rules if:
your business is based in China or the US
you dispatch parcels from a warehouse in China or the US to buyers in Poland, and
the net value of the goods in the parcel does not exceed 150 EUR (without VAT).
If necessary, the buyer will pay the VAT when collecting the parcel.

In the future, we might decide to voluntarily account for VAT from those B2C transactions, as well. If it happens, we will inform you about it in advance.
Even if we decide to voluntarily account for VAT in that case, we will not collect VAT on transactions over 150 EUR net. Instead, this information will be archived only.
The VAT e-commerce package in the settlements with Allegro
You can find your settlements for the VAT e-commerce package in your
billing
, as
VAT e-commerce
, and on the invoice we issue for our services.
On the invoice you will find separate items covering settlements for:
a comprehensive service
― subject to VAT, includes sales commissions, promotion fees, and so on
fees out of scope of VAT
― includes
eCommerce VAT
settlements.
You will not see the settlements out of scope of VAT on corrective invoices.

You can use the turnover discount to set discounts on your entire assortment
for business customers on business.allegro.cz
. This means you can only add it to the offers that
qualify for sharing
on Allegro Business in Czechia, and it will only be visible to Czech business customers. This discount will not be available to buyers on allegro.pl, allegro.sk, or allegro.hu.
How the turnover discount works
You set this discount for your entire assortment. You decide on the
discount percentage
and the
purchase threshold
— that is,
how many Czech korunas
the buyer needs to spend on your products in a month to qualify.
If you set the discount and the buyer spends the specified amount at your store the following month — they will be able to purchase products from you at discounted prices in the month after that.
If the buyer reaches the required threshold again, they will be able to benefit from the discount again in the following month — and so on.

If you add at least one photo while

, buyers will see its miniature form on the product list. A thumbnail showcases the product. Its purpose is to present the product you are selling as accurately as possible. Our research shows that product photos with white background are more attractive to buyers — a good photo increases the chances of sales by up to 12%. Products showcased on a uniform background present better in the search results.
The thumbnail always consists of the image that you
set first
in the listing form.
Setting a thumbnail is always free — regardless of the category in which you list a product.
Maximum size and resolution
On Allegro, you can upload images with a maximum resolution of 26 Mpx. The maximum image size we will display on Allegro is 2560 x 2560 pixels. We will proportionally scale images with a side longer than 2560 pixels to fit that size.
The longer side must be at least 400 pixels long.
Rules for presenting products
Products visible in the photos should typically be presented against a white background with no extra graphics. You can present multiple products if you sell them as a
set
.
Models can appear on the photo with the product — regardless of the category in which you list the offer.

When you list an offer, in the Allegro Product Catalog, you will not find images with visible faces — for instance of models. If our mechanism recognizes a face in an image, it hides the image from the Catalog and the product change request form.

You can place another shot of that product from a different angle in the same photo. Just make sure that buyers are not confused as to the number of units of the product you sell.
You can also include a demonstrative item, showing buyers the product they are buying and how to use it ― for example, a car radio with a remote. Based on the photo, the buyer should have no doubts about what they are buying.
If you sell a product in the original manufacturer's packaging, you can include it in the photo.
However, you cannot have your store's logo on the packaging photo.
Using logotypes
Do not place any logotypes — of a product or of your store. The rule does not apply if you sell designer products and a logotype is visible on it or its packaging.

A thumbnail is supposed to showcase the product so do not include any additional information, text, or pictographs.

What Allegro Buyer Protection is
Within Allegro Buyer Protection, a buyer may receive a refund of up to 20,000 PLN for a dissatisfactory purchase on Allegro or Allegro Lokalnie, especially when:
the parcel has not reached the buyer or some products are missing
you have not refunded the buyer after they have canceled their purchase or sent the product back
the product has turned out to be damaged or non-compliant with the description and you do not solve the issue within the return.
The definitions you will find in this article

It may mean that the product that the buyer bought:
belongs to someone else — for example, was stolen
is encumbered with another person's rights — for example, another person has the right of pre-emption
has limitations in use or disposal as a result of a decision or ruling of the appropriate authority — for example, the product has been secured in criminal proceedings as evidence in a case.

If you buy a product from an entrepreneur (that is, a person that runs a business or professional activity) and the purchase is not directly linked to the industry or specialization you work in — that is a
consumer purchase

the description should be complete and comprehensive — it cannot be cut off halfway

section

When you ship your orders to other European Union countries, make sure you do it legally. Pay particular attention to waste and packaging regulations — including those that apply in the country to which you are shipping. In this case — Slovakia.
If you sell products subject to the
extended producer responsibility (EPR)
to Slovakia, you should:
enter into relevant registers
comply with the recycling regulations
label your products properly.

In Slovakia, the rules concerning the extended producer responsibility are regulated by the
Zákon zo 17. marca 2015 o odpadoch a o zmene a doplnení niektorých zákonov
— the act also known as
suo
.
The act mentions the following product categories:
packaging (§ 52 suo)
non-packaged products (§ 73 suo)
electrical and electronic equipment (§ 32 suo)
batteries and accumulators (§ 42 suo)
vehicles (§ 60 suo).

Glossary — terms you should know
The entity that places the packaging on the market
— a person or a company that sells products in the packaging in Slovakia — even if they do not run a business activity in that country.
Packaging
— a product that allows proper transport, delivery, protection, and display of goods. It can be made of any material. It does not matter whether it is only used for transport and will be removed before the sale or the product will be sold in it.
Placing the packaging on the market
— the moment when the packaging (itself or with the product) enters Slovakia for the first time, for example, arrives from another country. It does not matter whether customers will use it on their own or resell it.
Packaging manufacturer
— a natural person that:
uses the packaging to pack goods and places them on the market under their trademark
is a person for whom the goods are packed and placed on the market under their trademark
places the packaged goods on the market in a way different from the ones described above or transports such goods or orders their transport abroad Slovakia and distributes or places them on another country's market
as a distributor, hands the packaging over to the end user for instant packing of goods, paid or free of charge
as a distributor, uses the packaging to wrap the distributed goods or their parts or to fill it with such goods
places the packaging on the

As a Polish seller that introduces their products onto the Slovak market:
Check whether the selling of selected products is allowed in Slovakia
. Remember that you have to comply with
Appendix No. 1 of Allegro Terms & Conditions
. You will find there the information on goods prohibited and restricted on Allegro.
Make sure you hold all the intellectual property rights
necessary to introduce the product in Slovakia (trademarks, patents, copyright).
If you sell products of animal or plant origin, electronics, dietary supplements, or pyrotechnic products, make sure to check the policy of selling products to Slovakia. Those are the examples of
product categories that require special attention
and are subject to additional regulations.
Make sure you have
entered the necessary registers
. Pay particular attention to waste and packaging regulations.

What the most important seller's obligations concerning waste and packaging are
According to the
act
, before you place products on the Slovak market, you need to register with the Slovak Ministry of the Environment. If you do not have a registered office in Slovakia, the most convenient way to fulfill this obligation is through a company with a special permit to collect packaging waste.
Check the list of approved manufacturer responsibility organizations
.
Enable the possibility to return packaging and explain to customers how and where they can do so.
Declare how much packaging you will place on the Slovak market.
If you mark what they are made of on the packaging, apply markings compliant with the
UE requirements
.
Make sure you recycle packaging.
If the local authorities ask you to provide proof that you meet those obligations — you have to do it.

The Slovak district office or environmental inspectorate
may impose a fine on you
if they find any non-compliance with the extended producer responsibility requirements in Slovakia.

Check also the additional obligations in specific product categories.

What obligations you need to meet
Register with the Slovak Ministry of the Environment.
Secure the collection, processing, and recycling of devices and electronic waste. This means your customer may return the used equipment stationary, by courier, or by an authorized third-party company — and you must provide them with the opportunity to do so

In the Allegro Product Catalog, we gather all products available on Allegro along with their edetails — such as parameters, images, or descriptions. This way, buyers can quickly find the product they ar searching for and easily compare all the offers with that product.
We regularly verify the links between offers and products to ensure their high quality. This allows us to provide buyers with clear and trustworthy information.

According to
Appendix 10
to our Terms & Conditions — as the seller, you are fully responsible for correctly linking your offer to a product in the Allegro Product Catalog.

We want buyers to be sure that your offer matches the exact product they are looking for. If your offers are incorrectly linked to a product from the Catalog, we can unlink them. We will then end your offer automatically. We will let you know about it by email.
We can unlink your offer from the Allegro Product Catalog if, among other things:
the offer title indicates a different product than the one presented
the basic parameters you provided in your offer differ from the product's details in the Catalog. You can check them in the Basic parameters section of the listing form.
the photos of the goods in the offer differ from the photos of the product
you provided a different number of units in the offer than in the product
you offer the goods in a color version not included for that product.
We can also take into account:
GTIN (EAN, ISBN, ISSN, or others) — a unique number that indicates the product itself
and not its owner
. This way, the same product can be linked to offers from different sellers.
information on whether the product's and offer's categories are in a
set of similar categories
.

The products in the Catalog are available to all sellers on Allegro. If your believe your offer is linked to the wrong product, you can report it to us. See the relevant provision in our Terms & Conditions:
According to Appendix 10 of the Allegro Terms & Conditions (Section 1.8): "Upon entering the data and content in relation to the Product proposal, the User creating the proposed and target Product shall give the Company the rights and consents specified in paragraphs 5.1 and 5.5 of the Allegro Terms & Conditions (which shall apply accordingly) in regard to all the content and elements. Upon entering the Product proposal, the User shall lose the ability to edit the data and content added to the Product specifications card.

How the AlleDiscount campaign works
You submit selected products from the

for the campaign.
We lower the prices of those products in your offers automatically.
Your offers are marked with the badge, for example, Allegro Days. Their lowest price from the last 30 days before the discount is also crossed out.
The customer buys the product at a discounted price.
The customer pays you the reduced price — we pay you reconciliation up to the product price from before the automatic reduction.
You do not bear any additional costs —
you can participate for free
.

More attractive prices in your offers ― without additional costs or losses in profit.
Offers positioned higher in the search results — when buyers sort by price: lowest first.
Higher sales ― buyers often choose a given offer because of the lower price.
Your offers have higher chances of being granted special badges — for example,

or

How we calculate the discount rate
We take into account the price you provide and the market prices of a given product. No matter what the final reduction is, we will pay you full reconciliation up to the price you suggest when you submit your offer.

Your current price in an offer is 105 PLN.
You reduce it to 100 PLN to meet the requirements from the List of Goods (Maximum Price for that product is 100 PLN).
We reduce it to 90 PLN — with the Minimum Discount.
A buyer purchases the product for 90 PLN.
You get 90 PLN from the buyer and a 10 PLN reconciliation from us.
We charge you the sales commission based on the price you set when submitting the offer — that is 100 PLN (the price suggested by you).

Note that a discount for that product may have been from 10% (Minimum Discount) to 60% (the Maximum Discount for all the products from the List). That is why the discounted product may cost between 90 PLN and 60 PLN ― your revenue remains the same.
We will return the amount by which we reduced your price to your Allegro bank account when a customer buys your product. You will find it in the

The Standard describes how to pack a parcel to reduce the risk of being charged additional fees by the carrier. We have prepared a list of recommended and non-recommended packing materials. We also suggest which materials you can use when dispatching heavy or irregularly-shaped products.
Why it is a good idea to follow our guidelines on packing parcels
You can save money by avoiding additional costs
— non-standard parcels need to be sorted manually, which is more expensive. If you decide to follow our Standard, you will facilitate their automatic sorting. This way, you may avoid additional fees charged by carriers.
Your products are better secured
— durable cardboard ensures protection during transport. Our guidelines may help you reduce the number of damaged parcels and complaints.
You strengthen your store's positive image
— a parcel that is aesthetic and easy to open provides a more pleasant unpacking experience and may encourage customers to buy from you again.
You are prepared for the introduction of new EU laws
— our Standard is based on the PPWR regulation. If you follow it now, you will be able to adjust to the new regulations faster.
You reduce waste
— we encourage you to use single-material or recycled packaging. This will facilitate waste segregation easier for buyers.

The PPWR is the
EU packaging and packaging waste regulation
. It specifies how to reduce the negative environmental impact of packaging. It also indicates which materials to use and how to prepare a parcel.
These guidelines will be implemented in phases — between August 2026 and 2030.

What packing materials we recommend
We recommend using recyclable materials like:
cardboard (the 3-ply or 5-ply type)
cardboard envelopes and book wraps
paper bags
paper void fillers (such as honeycomb wrap or crumbled paper)
paper tape or reinforced tape.
These are all PPWR-compliant materials.
What materials are not recommended
Avoid using materials that:
make automatic sorting difficult
are not recyclable
may damage other parcels in transport.
Example of such products are:
stretch wrap — excessive wrapping makes the package difficult to open
black stretch wrap — is not visible on the scanner, so such a parcel needs to be sorted manually
foil packs
products that are waste (such as empty beverage bottles)
sharp elements (for example, protruding staples, wires) — they can injure workers or damage other parcels
EPS foam — it can crumble and contaminate the sorting machines
materials that are not easily separated (like

In some cases, you may use plastic materials with at least 35% of recycled content. Use them if:
the weight of your shipment exceeds 30 kg — you can secure it with plastic tape
your shipment has an irregular shape or is on a pallet — you may use transparent stretch wrap
you are securing glass or fragile products — you may wrap them in bubble wrap
you are shipping liquids or paints — you may secure the lid, for example, with plastic tape.

If you are using
compostable material
, check if it has a certificate (for example, TUV Austria, OK Compost) and information about the waste bin it should go into. Such material decomposes in an environmentally safe way, but only if it is placed in the correct bin.
How to pack parcels
Match the packaging size to the product — avoid empty spaces and excessive void fill.
Select durable packaging — use 3-ply or 5-ply cardboard.
Make sure the parcel is easy to open — do not wrap the cardboard boxes with film or excessive amounts of tape. Thanks to this, the buyer will be able to quickly open your parcel.
Use a single material type — avoid mixing different materials to make waste segregation easier. For example, use paper tape for cardboard boxes, or use cartons with a self-adhesive tear strip.
Stick the label correctly — place it on the flat side of the parcel. Do not cover the barcode with tape, so the courier can scan it.
Match the parcel size to the size of the parcel lockers.
Secure liquids and perishable products — make sure they do not leak and damage other parcels. For example, tape the cap and stabilize the bottle inside the package.
Apply multi-use packaging — so that the buyer can use it to return or exchange the product.

Offers on Allegro are listed by different sellers, but many of them include the same products. Offers can differ in price and sales policy, but basic information about the product, for example, the manufacturer and brand, is the same.
In the Allegro Product Catalog, we gather
information about products
— names, parameters, photos, and descriptions, that are included in sellers' offers. We differentiate products by parameters such as Brand, Model, Manufacturer Code, and the
GTIN (the EAN code)

It can also
help sellers
a lot — you will spend less time preparing and listing offers. This allows you to focus on increasing your competitiveness in areas like sales policy and service quality.

There are offers of the same TV model from multiple sellers. We group them all under one product based on the GTIN (the EAN code). The buyer can see a
product list
in the search results that matches the searched phrase. Then, the buyer goes to the list of all offers from different sellers with the same product and chooses the offer that best suits their needs.

What you can gain with the Allegro Product Catalog
You can reduce the time of listing offers through the listing form by
up to 50%
, because we automatically complete the name, parameters, pictures, and description for you.
You can list offers more easily — when you enter the product's GTIN (the EAN code), you download the complete product data from the Catalog. You do not need to take professional pictures of the product or create descriptions. All you need to do is set your sales policy and delivery options.
Buyers who use the product list are more likely to add products to their carts and buy them more often.
Buyers can find products they are looking for more quickly — on each page of the list with sales results, we display
4 times more products
on average. As a result, buyers have access to a wider assortment and can reach offers from all sellers with the same product more easily.

How we grant the badge
Every day throughout the entire edition, we compare prices in offers on Allegro with prices in offers of other stores and shopping platforms. If, at the time of comparison, the product price in your offer is lower than or equal to the price of the same product sold by selected competitors, and it meets the conditions, it will
automatically
gain the special badge. Buyers will see it on the offer's page, the list of offers, and list of products.
If more than one offer meets the program requirements, we will grant the badge to the offer with the lowest total price. We calculate the total price by adding the product price and the delivery price. For offers with an Allegro Smart! delivery option, the delivery price will be 0 PLN.

The offer with the most units sold in the last 30 days will get the badge. If that number is the same – the offer that was listed first will get the badge.

The
Best Price Guarantee
badge is granted free of charge. We will display the badge throughout the entire edition of the program — as long as the offer meets its conditions.

Within the
Deal
badge, we display the percentage of an offer price discount. We calculate it in relation to the lowest price of a product in that offer in the last 30 days before the discount. That price is displayed crossed out.
If you share your offers in the foreign marketplaces, the lowest price from the last 30 days will be
different for each marketplace
where you share that offer.

In offers that we display to entrepreneurs, we do not determine a separate lowest price from the last 30 days. It means that, for example, on business.allegro.cz, we take into account the price from allegro.cz. On business.allegro.pl, on the other hand, we take into account the price from allegro.pl.

What offers we grant this badge to
We automatically grant the
Deal
badge to offers that:
include
a new product
— we do not grant the Deal badge to products for which the
Condition
parameter is not available
have had
their product price reduced by at least 5%
, but
no more than 60%
, compared to the lowest price in that offer in the last 30 days in the given marketplace
have been active on Allegro for
at least 24 hours
— we can determine the lowest price in the last 30 days only after that period
are not listed in one of the
categories excluded
from the campaign
have not been excluded from the campaign because we found them unattractive
— to determine that, we mostly take the price and sales performance into account.
How we determine the lowest price
We check the lowest prices of a given product on Allegro and in the market over the last three days. We calculate the median based on this data. To get the badge, your price must be equal to or lower than the median of the lowest prices from the last three days. We update the prices once a day.
We exclude offers if their price after the discount is higher than the median of the lowest price of that product from the last 3 days
. We determine the product price median once a day. We also check the offer's sales results, popularity, and buyers' interest. We exclude some offers because we want to offer buyers attractive products at reasonable prices and ensure high quality of the Deal badge.

For the given product, we take into account the price median from both offers for entrepreneurs and customers with a regular account. It means that even

There are more than 260 million offers on Allegro. Every minute, 38,000 queries about specific products appear. We are creating the Allegro Product Catalog to help customers navigate a wide range of products. With the Catalog, we organize the website navigation in multiple areas — from offer listing and sales management to how customers browse, search for, and compare offers.
What the product list is
On the product list, we display products for which we group available offers. To display the product list, go to the search results or the category page and click [combine the same offers]. First, we display the Allegro Ads sponsored offers. Then, in the section with
Promoted products

have the

Top offers

We do not display promoted products in a separate section in searching by relevance. The

section appears when the buyer selects different types of sorting, like sorting by price.

What makes the product list stand out
We display products (except for the first two positions with sponsored offers).
If there are many offers with the same product — we display the product only once. If the buyer decides to purchase the exact product, they can open the list of all the offers with that product.
We display each product's name and image from our Allegro Product Catalog.
We display selected parameters for each product.
On the product list, you can find the product of your interest first and later select a specific offer. You can filter products by the available parameters, for example, length, capacity, or the number of units. In selected categories, you will also find information about color variants of the product you are searching for.
The product list is short and transparent. Thanks to that, your customers can more quickly find the product they are searching for. As a seller, you do not need to worry about adding the proper offer title, high-quality images, or product parameters — those details are taken from the Allegro Product Catalog.
What you can find on the product page
We display the product page if the offer is linked to the Allegro Product Catalog. In other cases, we display the offer page.
We divided the product page into two columns:
in the left column, we display the offer title and information about the product's condition
in the right column, we display information about the seller and sales policy, for example:
price
estimated delivery

As a seller, you are liable within
the statutory warranty (for non-consumer purchases)
or
the lack of conformity of the goods with the agreement (for consumer purchases)
if your offer description does not inform about defects or the product’s non-conformity with the agreement.
How much time you have to address the complaint
You have
14 days
of filing a complaint by the buyer to consider it. If you do not do it within that time frame, the complaint is deemed upheld by you.
Consumer Sales
In case of a lack of conformity of the goods with the agreement, the buyer has the right to file a complaint. As stipulated in the
Allegro Complaints and Returns Policy
, they can file a complaint through the complaint form.
Filing the complaint by clicking [file a complaint or issue] in the purchase details and completing the relevant form —  describing the issue and indicating how they prefer you to handle the complaint:
the buyer can select repair, replacement, repair or replacement, or — if the defect is significant — withdrawal from the agreement and a full or partial refund
the repair or replacement should be carried out within a reasonable time frame and be free for the buyer
if making the goods conform to the contract in the way the buyer chose is impossible or overly costly, you can:
replace the product when the buyer demands fixing it
fix the product when the buyer demands replacing it.
The buyer may apply for a full or partial refund when:
the non-conformance of goods is severe enough to justify an immediate withdrawal from the agreement or lowering the price
you refuse to make the goods conform to the agreement due to it being impossible or too expensive
you will not make the goods conform to the agreement
you are unable to make the goods conform to the agreement in a reasonable time or without undue inconvenience
despite your attempts to make the goods conform to the agreement (by fixing or replacing them), the non-conformance is still present.
If you accept the buyer's complaint and decide to refund them — you click [accept and refund payment] we will automatically insert the buyer's details and refund amount in the complaint chat.
Ensure the details are correct and click [refund payment].
The limitation period of claims
Check the key deadlines.
The complaint claim may expire after 6 years.
Within 2 years of delivery, the seller should be able to prove that the goods conformed to the contract at the moment of their delivery to the buyer.

We created a separate chat for handling complaints to make the process more convenient. You will find the chat in the complaint details in the

product inconsistent with the offer — for example, its description, images, or parameters
product delivered with damage
defect identified during use
missing product elements — for example, a screw
my reason is not on the list.
Three days after submitting a complaint, the buyer can ask our consultant for help in the complaint chat.

In the complaint chat, you can also report the buyers' messages that contain:
threats — messages saying that you or your relatives will get hurt if you do not fulfill the buyer’s expectations
pornographic content.
To do that, use the [submit] option available next to the message you want to report. In the form, choose the reason for the report and confirm that you are sending it in good faith. You can also add a more detailed description of the situation.

How you can manage complaints
You can find all the complaints in the
Complaints and Discussions
with buyers tab. They are marked with a special badge —
Complaint
. To manage them:
Go to the
Complaints and Discussions with buyers
tab and select a complaint.
Make sure that the buyer provided all information necessary to process the complaint.
If the description lacks information or images that could help you process it, click [ask for additional information]. Enter the additional information you need and confirm you want to send the message. You and the buyer will see your message in the chat, below the steps of handling a complaint.
Step 1
: Select how the buyer should return the product. Click [without product return] if the buyer does not need to send the product back to you. If you click [schedule a return], specify how you will collect the product from the buyer.  We recommend taking this step within the first 3 days after the buyer files a complaint. This allows them to quickly deliver the product that the complaint concerns to you for inspection — if

Step 2

If you accept the complaint, you can change the buyer’s preferred solution to another one.

. Go through all the steps to handle complaints efficiently. You have 14 days to decide on the complaint.  If you do not inform the buyer of your decision within this time, they will be able to apply for a refund from the Allegro Buyer Protection program. We will add that compensation to your bill.

When the buyer sends the product back to you as part of the complaint
The product should come properly secured. The buyer does not need to send the product back in its original packaging or enclose a receipt.
What if you reject the customer's complaint
If you reject the customer's complaint:
refer to the specific parts of the customer's complaint. Indicate which ones are unfounded and why.
rely on factual arguments that are supported by evidence, such as expert opinions, technical documentation, or conversation transcripts
refer to the law or provisions of the agreement — in the justification, clearly state the legal or agreement-related basis on which you reject the complaint
be clear and precise — use simple language that the buyer can easily understand
respond to all of the buyer's claims, regardless of whether they relate to the product's non-compliance with the agreement.

If you refer the buyer to the warrantor, such as the manufacturer, this is not equivalent to you having processed the complaint.

If you reject the buyer's claims, according to the
Polish Act on consumer rights
(available in Polish),  you must return the product to them at your expense.

If you accidentally send the buyer a product different than the one they have ordered, they should file a complaint due to the product's non-conformity with the agreement. Talk to the buyer and agree on:
how they can return the incorrect product — you can ask the customer to send the product back or leave it with them
how you will send them the correct product.
Complaint decision and return
If the product purchased by the customer does not comply with the agreement, is damaged, or has a defect, and the customer wants to file a complaint — you, as a seller, can expect the product to be sent back or made available for inspection. You cover the costs of repair or replacement, including, in particular, the postal fees and the cost of transport, labor, and materials.
Filing a complaint is free for the buyer — regardless of the decision you make. You are obliged to refund the buyer for all the costs they bore in regard to the transaction — for example, the total cost of assembly or installation of the device. The buyer should make the defective goods available to you so can fix them. As a seller, you are obliged to collect the product from the buyer at your expense — you can, for example, provide the buyer with a return label or collect the product on your own.

When you ship your orders to other EU countries, do it legally. Pay particular attention to waste and packaging regulations — including those that apply in the country you are shipping to, in this case, Czechia.

Remember that this article only contains guidelines — they do not constitute legal advice.

The
entity that places the packaging on the market
is a person or a company that sells products in the packaging in Czechia — even if they do not run a business activity in that country.
Packaging
is a product that allows transporting and delivering goods, protecting them, or displaying them correctly. It can be made of any material. It does not matter whether it is only used for transport and will be removed before the sale or the product will be sold in it.
Placing the packaging on the market
is when the packaging (itself or with the product) enters Czechia for the first time, for example, arrives from another country. It does not matter whether customers will use it on their own or resell it.

What are the most important obligations of the seller
Make sure your packaging meets requirements an
quality standards
.
If you place labels on your packaging to show what it is made of, make sure to do it in line with appropriate
EU regulations
.
Guarantee that packaging can be returned and explain to customers how and where they can do so. If you do not have a registered office in Czechia, the most convenient way to fulfill this obligation is through a company with a special permit to collect packaging waste.
Make sure that the packaging you placed on the market is recycled.
Sign up for the List of Entities (
check when you do not need to do it
).
It is your obligation to prove to the local authorities that you meet those obligations.

If in a given calendar year you place on the Czech market packages that weigh less than 300 kg in total and your annual turnover is less than 25 million CZK, you are not subject to the obligations referred to in paragraphs 3, 4, and 5.
When calculating the annual turnover, account for all marketplaces you sell in.

If you carry out large-scale sales, managing individual orders manually can be burdensome. The API allows you to automatize multiple processes, as well as manage several sales channels in one place. With that, you can also make your sales on Allegro more efficient.
What the Allegro API is all about
The Allegro API is a programming interface with precisely defined rules and their descriptions. It allows
the exchange of information between the Allegro assets and external software
, such as a warehouse or accounting system. With the Allegro API, developers can combine their solutions with our mechanism.
If you process a lot of orders every day, the API will make your work easier and save you some time. With the Allegro API you can
automatize the whole sales process
― from listing offers and managing orders and payments, to ordering dispatch, issuing invoices, monitoring sales, and post-purchase contact with customers.
How the Allegro API can make your work easier
Among other things, the Allegro API allows you to:
list and edit multiple offers in bulk

You can integrate the majority of platforms used by online stores with the Allegro API. Ask your sales management software provider about the option to integrate it with Allegro.

If you do not use ready-made solutions and your system is custom-made, you will most likely need a developer's support.

If you do not use external tools at all, you can find an appropriate app on your own. You can find a lot of solutions online that use our API and will help you manage sales. Google the phrase:
integration with Allegro
.

What the sales quality is
The sales quality is an overall rating of your activity on Allegro. We calculate it based on the data from your account concerning, for example, your contact with customers, delivery speed, or buyer satisfaction. We convert this data into points that we grant in specific metrics. That way we know whether your sales quality is at the Super or Needs improvement level.
How we calculate points for sales quality
We grant points in 8 metrics and recalculate them every day. For most of the metrics, we calculate points based on data
from the last 30 days
. There are two exceptions:
On-time dispatch
and
Fast dispatch
. In those metrics, we consider orders for which the dispatch time or expected delivery time displayed in the offer at the moment of purchase has expired
within the last 28 days
. We look at the later of those dates.
The score displayed in the
My Sales Quality
tab is calculated for the previous day (from the data we collect between 00:00 a.m. and 11:59 p.m.).
We display points for the sales quality only to those sellers who had at least 1 active offer within the last 30 days.
Note that the score is calculated only for an account from which you access the tab. If you have several accounts, you can check your sales quality score for a specific account when you sign in to it.
Only you can see your sales quality score. We do not share your scores with others.
Within the sales quality, we grant points for your activity in each marketplace. That is why, if you sell in foreign marketplaces, in the
My Sales Quality
tab, you see scores
we calculate based on data from all marketplaces

Bear in mind that sales quality is just one of the factors that may influence your sales results. There are others, such as price or delivery time. This is why we cannot guarantee that your sales performance will grow when you raise sales quality.
To calculate these values, we use the Allegro Analytics data. See the details of the process below.
We check the number of all transactions on Allegro from the last 30 days.
To each transaction, we assign the sales quality level the seller had at the moment of purchase.
For each of those 30 days, we check the number of sellers with a given sales quality level.
We calculate the daily sales value based on those transactions. We convert the value of orders placed in foreign currencies into PLN according to the conversion rate from the day of purchase.
We divide the daily sales value by the number of sellers (split by their sales quality level).
The result is the average daily sales value for each sales quality level. Then, we convert it into a percentage value.
We compare this data and use it as a basis to display how the sales quality level correlates with sales results.
If your level is Super
, the chart will show how values change between specific levels — between Neutral and Good, Good and Super, and so on.
If your level is different than Super
, the chart will show how values change between specific levels and your sales quality level.

your request sent to the buyer through the Message Center

What the wholesale discounts are and how they work
The
wholesale discount
allows you to offer discounts to entrepreneurs. You decide on your own how many units the customer needs to buy to get a specific discount. That way you determine the thresholds in the price list of a given discount — the more units the customer buys, the higher discount they get.

If the customer buys at least 20 units, they will get a discount of 5%. If the customer buys at least 50 units, they will get a discount of 10%. If the customer buys 100 units, they will get a discount of 25% and so on.

You decide about a number of units and a discount rate for each threshold.
Who can use wholesale discounts
You can create the wholesale discount and add it to offers
only
if you sell on a business account.
It will be visible and available
only
to entrepreneurs making business purchases on Allegro Business in Poland and Czechia:
business.allegro.pl
and
business.allegro.cz
.
Learn more about
Allegro Business
and see how to grow your B2B sales.
How to create a wholesale price list
You can create the wholesale discounts in the appropriate tab or through the
Allegro API
.
Go to the
wholesale discount settings
.
Click [add discount].
Name the price list for that discount — it will help you manage the wholesale discounts.
Determine how many units the customer needs to buy to benefit from the discount and enter the applicable discount for each threshold.
Click [save price list].
Your discount is ready! You just need to
add it to offers
.

If you want to make the most of the wholesale discount, create a few price lists for different categories and products.

How to assign a wholesale price list to an offer
You can add the wholesale discount to all offers or to some of them — it is up to you!
Open the
My Assortment

Open the

Other

You will see the names of all your wholesale price lists. Select the one you want to assign to selected offers.

The tab features information about:

number of products the withdrawal concerns
tracking number for the withdrawn products we are sending back to you — provided that we have not disposed of them.
Additionally, if you click on the withdrawal number, we will display more details. You can learn:

whether the withdrawal concerns full-value products or not
the type of product and number of units the withdrawal order involves.
What we do with products unsuitable for sale
If you selected send back to the specified address in Europe on your account
We will send the products to the address you indicated but only if their condition allows that. These may include products:
fulfillable, with the expiration date shorter than 60 days
unfulfillable, returned by buyers
unfulfillable — damaged in the warehouse
unfulfillable — damaged in transport: from the warehouse to the buyer or from the buyer to the warehouse (in the case of returns)
unfulfillable — with a hidden defect
unfulfillable —textile products.
If the condition of a product does not allow its return, we will dispose of it.
We send back products unsuitable for sale
once per month or when they exceed a specific warehouse capacity
. After we do so, we will email you the information about the carrier and parcel number. We will also attach the link to the details in the
Withdrawals
tab.

We will charge the fee for withdrawing products from the warehouse for each unit that is:

and unfit for sale because, for example, it has a hidden defect
unfulfillable
and has been returned by a customer
fulfillable

or
you want to withdraw it.
We will charge the fee next Monday after withdrawing the products from the warehouse. If that Monday is a holiday — we will charge it on the next business day.
To the fee we will add:
if the products are sent back
— shipping costs based on the carrier's invoice. They depend on the carrier's price list and the weight, volume, type, and value (in the case of insured parcels) of the products we send back to you.
if the products are disposed of

price list
.
